claim_class: COMPUTED from the two published rasters and the catalogue raster
owner_page_sha256_note: the owner page publishes this SHA-256; it was not byte-matched here because the raw.githubusercontent host is unreachable from the sandbox

prune_test.rule: remove every D2.8 cell within 100 m (one cell) of the public catalogue

nearest_neighbour_spacing_m.note: 100 m cells; 300 m is the metric's triangular-kernel support, so a dotted emission at this spacing still reaches almost every truth pixel while paying 0.2 of the denominator per dot
